featured_reviews.review_text:
As one enters the shop everything looks very clean and organised. The staff is well trained in informing about their history, exchanging pleasantries and manages to put up a smile but what actually matters is their Mithais that they are selling which are not fresh!!!

This was the first time I bought an Ice Halwa, varieties of Pedas (white & brown) and some khakharas. They don't provide any sample tasting of their Mithais. Later upon the manager's intervention I was given a small sample of their brown peda which was fresh but not the other white peda or the Ice Halwa... I found that odd but went ahead on the trust of their rich legacy which was told to me by their staff... This was the first red flag.

Even though the staff knew that the sweets have gone stale they still sold it to me.  Upon tasting, I found out the truth about their stale mithai and also found out that they had not provided me with an invoice :-( Second red flag.

Now as I join the dots and it all makes sense that they probably have got good at clearing their stale products off the shelf and making money...
This was not experience that I had hoped for...

featured_reviews.name: afrin khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
We have always prepared khasta (tikiya) and gujiya (karanji) at home. But due to some reasons we could not prepare this time and saw their reels on Instagram for Niyaz. I ordered from them for 22 Rajab niyaz and honestly I absolutely loved it !

The quality of their food products is exceptional, and you can truly taste the freshness in every bite. From khasta, gujiya, gond laddoo, special banglore stuffed naan, cake everything I've tried has been delicious.
They were generous enough to send me laddoo, naan and cake as a token of appreciation.

Their packaging is top-notch, keeping everything fresh and easy to store. Plus, the ingredients are wholesome and natural, which I really appreciate as someone who values quality over anything else. They ensured that the order was delivered as per the time specified and in good condition.

Highly recommend U.P.Dairy and sweets to anyone looking for reliable, good quality and tasty products for their niyaz. Definitely a 5-star experience!

featured_reviews.name: Ammar Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Congratulations on the Diamond Jubilee of the U. P. Dairy & Sweets- indeed a diamond quality shop!
The shop had a great variety of options available to chose from, from traditional favorites to new delicacies. The staff were knowledgeable, efficient and friendly and the shop was clean and inviting. The sweets were fresh, flavorful, and made with high-quality ingredients. Even though their standards are high, the pricing is very reasonable and fair; and now that they even provide free delivery is a treat!

It's also interesting to see that people have left Namaaz and are standing in line to get their Niyaz-Fatiha Mithai from their favorite Doodh-Mithai store on the auspicious night of Shab-e-Bara’at! ☺️

We grew up eating sweets from here, the owners would treat the customers, staff, and workers like family. We would love to go to the shop everyday after returning from school. As someone mentioned in their review, it was and is a hallmark of sweetmeat across south Mumbai. The fact that the shop has been running even after 75 years and is still in the family and the 4th generation is continuing the legacy, is a testimony of its test through times and tastes! May Allah give them Barakah in their sweets and family and increase them in taste and sweetness.

I have heard that many Halwais who learned the art of culinary here, under the leadership and mentorship of the great pioneer and leader, Najju Seth RA, have opened their own shops and running a successful business in different parts of the country and abroad.

Overall, I highly recommend U. P. Dairy & Sweets for anyone looking for delicious and high-quality mithai. The combination of delicious sweets, great variety of options, excellent customer service, and fair pricing make this shop a real standout far beyond a century!

name: Brijwasi Sweets, Original Since 1946 - GD Group - Nana Chowk
description:
In the early forties, a young man from Braj in Mathura, landed on the shores of the bustling metropolis called Mumbai. He arrived with a dream to have his own shop selling traditional mithais from his beloved Braj Bhoomi. While he established his first outlet in Kalbadevi, little did he know that he was in fact pioneering a leading chain of stores which would one day become a household name! This was our patriarch Ramswarup ji...

Subsequently, his son Bankelalji, and his succeeding present generations, have grown from strength to strength from that first outlet to several others across the city today. We continue to follow the age old traditional recipes to bring you the finest flavours in our products.

featured_reviews.name: Poushalee Dey
featured_reviews.review_text:
CRÈME Cookies – A Warm, Gooey Delight in Tardeo

CRÈME Cookies, a recent addition to Mumbai’s dessert scene, specializes in thick, chunky, New York-style cookies that promise a perfect balance of crisp edges and gooey centers. Tucked away in Tardeo, this spot has already built a reputation for serving some of the most indulgent cookies in the city.

From the moment we walked in, the aroma of freshly baked cookies filled the air, setting the perfect mood for a sugar rush. We ordered a mix of their bestsellers, including classic chocolate, Nutella-filled creations, and a couple of their signature cake cups. Each bite was rich, buttery, and decadent without being overly sweet. The cookies were served warm and fresh, with a satisfyingly soft, melt-in-the-mouth texture. The cake cups, too, were indulgent, though some flavors stood out more than others.

While the flavors were spot on, we felt that some cookies could have used a bit more contrast in texture, perhaps a slightly crispier exterior to balance out the gooey center. The cake cups, while tasty, could have packed a little more depth in certain flavors. That said, CRÈME definitely knows how to make a seriously good cookie.

With a premium price tag, it’s not an everyday indulgence, but for anyone who loves big, bold, and gooey cookies, CRÈME is absolutely worth a visit. A strong 4/5 from us—nearly perfect, and dangerously addictive.

Would we return? Without a doubt.

featured_reviews.name: Pratik Gadgil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Simplicity should convince

Would a simple white-walled structure with no frills convince you to visit a dear sweet shop in a world where even the smallest of the establishments try to get in some style or decor, if not vibrance, to attract customers? Well, they say they don't judge a book by its cover, and this shop says they don't make hunches without seeing the product. Generally, a sweet shop does have some farsan / namkeen items and a repertoire of sweets; this one has only selected categories of sweets. Is that a niche? I am somewhere in between for that. Add to that the bygone and nasty phrase, "We only accept cash" ( more on that, later ); it must feel hard to see it in today's world.

On my two visits here, I bought the following items:

1. Kala Kand Pista & Strawberry flavour -  Very sweet, albeit not dulcified, but most importantly, felt like a coloured filling of sugar assembled under the tag of kala kand; I have eaten far better Kala Kands before and at relatively lower prices.

2. Kaju Katli - superb. Some like it hard, some like it soft. The pieces were big -- probably the biggest I have had; coated with silver, reasonably sweet and medium hard.

3. Walnut Halwa - The best of the lot!  A rich walnut flavour dessert sprinkled with pieces of almonds, reasonably sweet in taste but one could feel the taste of real walnuts. Very authentic!

At Rs 1,600 a kg, it is at least 20% higher than the average market rate, but if you are undecided and open to all options, the first one you should go for is the Walnut Halwa.

4. Mawa roll - a richly textured roll containing dry fruits and made in ghee. It was delicious, but do keep in mind that it might not be for everyone's appetite.

The staff was very friendly and one doesn't often see the staff giving an entire piece of Kaju Katli just to taste. I still dared to ask them for online payment; they said, yes. So, I suppose, for purchases over a certain amount, GPay/PhonePe is accepted.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Headline: Extremely Arrogant Staff & Pathetic Service!
Bahut hi ghatiya experience raha Sudhir Sweets par. In logo ko shayad ye bhool gaya hai ki ye customers ki wajah se chal rahe hain.
Arrogant Behaviour: Yahan ka staff aur management itne battameez hain ki unhe baat karne ki bilkul tameez nahi hai. Customer se aise baat karte hain jaise hum par ehsaan kar rahe ho.
No Tasting Policy: Ek mithai ki dukaan par baithe hain aur kehte hain ki taste nahi karne denge! Bina check kiye koi itni mehngi mithai kaise le le? Aisa lagta hai jaise kuch chhupa rahe hain ya purana maal bech rahe hain.

featured_reviews.review_translated_text:
Headline: Extremely Arrogant Staff & Pathetic Service!
Had a very poor experience at Sudhir Sweets. They seem to have forgotten that their business is run by their customers.
Arrogant Behavior: The staff and management are so indecisive that they have no idea how to communicate. They talk to customers as if they're doing us a favor.
No Tasting Policy: We're sitting in a sweet shop and they say they won't let us taste it! How can anyone buy such expensive sweets without checking them? It seems like they're hiding something or selling old goods.
Dishonest Vibes: Their attitude is like that of a thief—just take the money and drive the customer away. There's no assurance of quality, and service is negative.

featured_reviews.name: Hozefa Topiwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
★★★★

Morbiwala is a fantastic Farsan store that offers a wide variety of delectable snacks. They have an extensive selection of Farsan products that cater to various tastes and preferences. However, I must mention that their prices are slightly higher compared to other stores.

On some occasions, we did encounter a minor issue with the Farsan not being as crispy as we would have liked. Nevertheless, their unique offerings such as "Chole Fari Khakada" and "Butter Chakri" are simply delightful and worth trying.

Despite the occasional crispiness concern and pricing, Morbiwala remains a go-to destination for those seeking a diverse range of Farsan treats. It's definitely a store worth exploring for any Farsan enthusiast.
